Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Payments (Demo) team.

Sprint goal: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 6 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, quick check: is story 3 done, is story 4 done, is task 15 done, and is task 19 done—and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12?

What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, and today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests.

story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Who can help unblock this while you’re waiting for the idempotency keys to be in?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.
Daniel, task 15, Add structured logging to gateway client, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Structured logging is nearly done. I'll finish it today.
Thanks, Daniel. Maya, are story 5 and bug 12 done, and what did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline; I will add it to the parking lot, and Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for bug 12 where the sandbox gateway keeps timing out and you need access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker and commitment: The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review, and you’ll chase them today; this blocker will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya. Admin, is task 14 done from your earlier “I should finish it tomorrow,” and is story 1 done from your “Keep working on the payment retry story today”?

What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.
task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slipped because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
For task 14, which slipped because the sandbox was down and you plan to finish tomorrow, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker: Blocked by the sandbox and platform team coordination, and it will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

We had blockers raised: one item is on track and will resume once idempotency keys are in, one person is blocked on bug 12 due to sandbox gateway timeouts and needs access to the platform team’s staging gateway, PCI scan exceptions are waiting on security review, and work was blocked by sandbox downtime and platform team coordination. We also parked an offline side discussion about the gateway timeout issue. One flagged item wasn’t covered: task 19, and the owners will get a follow-up about it. Follow-ups, including for anyone absent or who didn’t respond, are coming in Teams. Thanks, everyone.
